description: Predeclared broad-corpus evaluation for fresh-context coding agents. The compiler and Parley instruction core are frozen before any session runs. Tasks are intentionally distinct from both the seed corpus and the three-task confirmation corpus.

predeclared_analysis.role: Out-of-sample diagnostic evidence, not a tuning target or a publishable language ranking.
predeclared_analysis.matrix: 8 tasks x 3 languages x 2 replicates = 48 fresh sessions
predeclared_analysis.reporting: Report the complete corpus and every task-language cell, including failures and outliers.
predeclared_analysis.change_rule: Do not change the compiler or language because of one task or transcript. A future proposal must address evidence recurring across at least two unrelated tasks and independently satisfy general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability.

tasks.title: Stable word deduplication
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N nonempty lowercase ASCII words, one per line. Keep only the first occurrence of each distinct word and print the retained words on one line joined by `|`, in their original order. If N is zero, print one empty line.

tasks.title: Run-length encoding
tasks.statement: Read one input line containing only lowercase ASCII letters; the line may be empty. Replace each maximal consecutive run with `letter:count` and print the groups on one line joined by commas. Preserve run order. For an empty input line, print one empty line.

tasks.title: Moving window sums
tasks.statement: Read a positive integer N, then a positive integer K, from the first two input lines. Read exactly N signed whole numbers, one per line. It is guaranteed that K is at most N. For every contiguous window of K values, print its sum. Print all sums on one line joined by commas with no spaces.

tasks.title: Longest rising run
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N signed whole numbers, one per line. Print the length of the longest contiguous run in which every value is strictly greater than the value immediately before it. If N is zero, print `0`.

tasks.title: Plurality winner
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N nonempty lowercase ASCII names, one per line. Count the occurrences of each name. Print the name with the greatest count, one space, and its count. Break a tie by choosing the alphabetically earliest name. If N is zero, print nothing.

tasks.title: Merge sorted intervals
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N closed integer intervals. Each interval line contains `start end`; start is at most end. The intervals are sorted by start, then by end. Merge intervals that overlap or share an endpoint: merge the next interval exactly when its start is at most the current merged end. Print the merged intervals on one line as `start:end` joined by commas, with no spaces. If N is zero, print one empty line.

tasks.title: Rotate words left
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N, then a non-negative integer K, from the first two input lines. Read exactly N nonempty lowercase ASCII words, one per line. Rotate the sequence left by K positions, treating K modulo N when N is positive. Print the rotated words on one line joined by `|`. If N is zero, print one empty line.

tasks.title: Longest common prefix
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N lowercase ASCII text lines; a text line may be empty. Print the longest prefix shared by all N lines, followed by a newline. If N is zero, or if the lines share no nonempty prefix, print one empty line.
